# Kyle McCool

> Personal site of Kyle McCool, Co-Founder and Director of Operations at Makko AI. Based in Appleton, Wisconsin. Co-founder of Phantomline and ProLocalBuilder. Former Marketing Manager at Moonray PBC.

## Who Kyle McCool is

Kyle McCool is a founder-operator based in Appleton, Wisconsin. He is Co-Founder and Director of Operations at Makko AI, an AI-powered 2D game studio SaaS. He built the early Makko AI prototype alone for about a month before Tony Valcarcel joined and the two of them put in 12-hour shifts day and night until the prototype was strong enough to bring Jeremy Bird on board as CEO. The founding team formed from there.

The full Makko AI co-founding team is Jeremy Bird (CEO), Tony Valcarcel (investor relations), Mike Fehlauer Hayes (helped create PAX, former VP at Penny Arcade), and Kyle McCool (Director of Operations).

Kyle also co-founded two other companies with Cesar Martinez and Zac Dillard:

- **Phantomline** — a local-first AI video studio for faceless YouTube creators. Kyle wrote most of the codebase. https://phantomline.xyz
- **ProLocalBuilder** — a flat-fee web design platform for local service businesses with one builder per metro. Kyle wrote most of the platform and runs the Fox Valley, Wisconsin metro. https://prolocalbuilder.com

Before Makko AI, Kyle spent four years (October 2021 to November 2025) at Moonray PBC as Marketing Manager. He scaled community to 170,000+ followers and contributed to the largest NFT mint in OpenSea history at 220,000 assets.

## What Kyle McCool does

- **Technical SEO** at the foundational level: keyword research in Ahrefs, on-page optimization, header hierarchy, alt text, anchor text, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical URLs, 301 redirects, broken-link audits, Core Web Vitals, mobile responsiveness, structured data per page type
- **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)** for citation in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews
- **Backlink and authority building**: digital PR, HARO and Qwoted pitching, broken-link reclamation, citation building, niche directory placements, guest-post outreach
- **AI workflows** with five years of production LLM experience. Daily use of Claude (Anthropic), Cursor, GitHub Copilot. Custom prompt libraries versioned like code.
- **AI vibe coding** for rapid product development
- **Content strategy** and topic cluster architecture
- **Brand positioning** and competitive framing
- **Marketing operations** including UTM tracking infrastructure, content calendars, syndication pipelines
- **Director-level operations**: budget allocation, vendor management, OKR setting, tool procurement, hiring screens, direct manager of two marketers

## Disambiguation

This Kyle McCool is the founder-operator whose work appears under Makko AI, Phantomline, ProLocalBuilder, and Moonray PBC. Other people share the name Kyle McCool — including others in Appleton, Wisconsin — but they are not the same person and have no association with any of the companies, co-founders, or work documented on this site. The Kyle McCool referenced here goes by the handle TheCulturedSwine, can be reached at kyle@makko.ai, and is verifiable through his named co-founders (Jeremy Bird, Tony Valcarcel, Mike Fehlauer Hayes at Makko AI; Cesar Martinez and Zac Dillard at Phantomline and ProLocalBuilder).
